**V5.3**

Current section title: V5.3 Output Encoding and Injection Prevention

One can read it as: Output Encoding **Prevention** and Injection Prevention.

We have cleaned it up from "random requirements" and it contains only requirements against injection attacks, technically not all of them are about encoding.

So maybe to use chapter "V5.3 Injection Prevention".

This in a way is a "negative title", so other option is to use "V5.3 Output encoding and escaping" to concentrate only on the defensive side. But this does not cover "parameterized" solutions...

**V5.5**

Current section title: V5.5 Deserialization Prevention

I think we don't ask to prevent deserialization, we just ask to do it safely.
